translated_title: Sheinbaum: Trump’s Racism and Migrant Raids Contributed to Latinos Giving Their Vote to the Democrats
original_title: Sheinbaum: racismo y redadas migrantes de Trump contribuyeron a que latinos dieran su voto a los demócratas
author: Alma E. Muñoz and Lilian Hernández
meta_description: Analyses show many Latino voters, including Mexican Americans, who backed Trump in 2024 switched to the Democratic Party in Tuesday’s U.S. elections.
